fits: You reach the back but want a structured study of the hand-fighting stage.
consider_alternative_if: If reaching the back is your main problem, use the broader Back Attack System guide to locate the entry volumes.

includes: Alignment problems, grip categories and underarm/overarm-side study.
The course later branches into auxiliary attacks and back entries.
limits: This route concentrates on hand fighting from established back control; use the broader guide when reaching the back is the main problem.

start_here.title: Separate control questions from finishing questions
start_here.task: Open the free contents and compare the alignment, grip and neck-access headings. Sort one question into each category. If you have the course, start with the limitations lesson and note a stated boundary before selecting a later chapter.
